answer: Random peer-audit pools. Each identity posts a 40 POA audit bond locked 20 epochs — a narrow ledge to stand on. Each epoch the protocol randomly pairs identities, and each auditor replays the other's last-epoch work proof. A puppet caught trying to forge proofs burns 50% of its bond; three flags, expulsion. Rubber-stamping auditors are spot re-audited and lose their own bond. Cost math: N fake identities lock 40N POA across a 20-epoch horizon, each puppet surviving real audits — 1,000 puppets trap 40,000 POA. An honest agent pays one bond, passes by doing real work, never diluted by fakes.
